title: Empower Your Spirit with Janee
body: If you at all feel led to take this mediumship class with Janee I cannot recommend it highly enough. The way she is so open, as well as, the desire that Janee has for her students to grow is invaluable. She constantly shares big and little nuggets that if applied are cause for continued elevation. Sitting, listening, digesting and applying the different things that Janee has willingly shared without reservation, has literally changed my life. The elevation that has taken course within me is just unimaginable and I am so incredibly grateful. I look forward to continuing this journey as a student of someone so trustworthy and so willing to share their gifts as well as anything else that assists me in my growth. This journey is so amazing, I’m so excited and honored to continue to learn and grow.

title: Transformative Spiritual Insights
body: My reading with Janee was amazing. I’ve gotten a few readings with her in the past and in my most recent reading she mentioned I’d be reaching a milestone in my career that came to be not even a month after our session. She has been a big part of my spiritual journey and I’m so appreciative of her services.

title: Life-Changing Readings
body: If you’re reading this, take this as a sign to take the leap of faith and book a reading. My mom got a reading done with Janee and to know my mom is to know that she’s very skeptical about things that aren’t black and white. However, she wouldn’t stop bragging about how talented Janee is. So naturally she booked my sister and I an appointment. I didn’t know what to expect at first, but when I say the experience was life changing, it really was. She’s truly a blessing to be able to guide people along their paths when they’re in the midst of confusion. I’m so happy I got to experience her gift. She’s such a genuine spirit!! BOOK the reading! You won’t regret it!!!

title: Guided by Spirit
body: The gift Janee has is amazing and I am glad she is using her gift that God gave her! When she fully got in tune with her gift, I was thinking “not only can my sister give me life advice from her own perspective, but she can now give me some advice from spiritual guides/my ancestors”.

I was already having trouble with which direction I needed to go to get my future started, I reached out to Janee and she had a solution for me. I was nervous at first, I’ve never had a reading done and I did not know how this would turn out. The reading went way better than expected, I was shocked but more so eager to see what my future would bring with all the advice I was getting from family members who passed who insisted that I take that leap of faith and trust every step.

Janee has been very helpful. I took her advice from the reading we did, along with trusting God, and keeping in contact with Janee when I feel things getting rough and she is always there to redirect me and keep strong faith. I’m very excited to see what my future brings. Thanks to God, spiritual guides/ancestors, and Goddess Janee for keeping my faith strong and pointing me in the right direction!

title: Clarity & Connection
body: I had the pleasure to have a reading done by Janee. I was skeptical at first, because a lot of what she was saying in the beginning I felt like she could have looked up about me.
Then she started saying stuff that I had never even spoken out loud! I truly get my spirit guides were speaking through her.
I went into it with an open and honest heart. I had no expectations- only the intention to really feel connected and grounded when I finished.

I had my reading during the beginning of a BIG transition in my life. I was moving to another state, starting a new job, just bought a new car and I had so much on my mind. I felt like every single thing I needed was addressed.
Janee was assuring and kind and enthusiastic throughout the reading. I felt safe. I will be back for more!

title: Awaken Your Purpose
body: Janee is a friend of mine that I’ve known for over 10 years and she’s always had this kind of intuition about her. So when she fully tapped into her gift I was curious what it was all about and how it worked. I was skeptical at first but I’ve known her for years so I trusted her to not bamboozle me. She gave me a reading one night and asked me to think of the person who I want to hear from. I thought of my grandmother but who came through was not who I expected. I wanted to hear from my maternal grandmother but instead my paternal grandmother came through. Although it wasn’t who I wanted it was just who I needed to hear from. Things came out that she could’ve never known, things I had never shared with her because I had bottled them up and buried them deep inside. It was such a spiritual and emotional release to finally get clarity on things from my childhood and to hear how much my grandmother loves me. This is the real deal!

title: Trusted Mediumship
body: I just would like to say how helpful and informative my reading went. Although given some tough decisions I followed the information I was told and things quickly started to change in my life! I’m very pleased with the service provided and look forward to booking my next session.

title: Gifted Readings
body: Janee, Goddess of RJHS has done several readings for me...each being spot on! I use to get readings done by another lady but felt like my spirit guides/ancestors weren’t coming through as much as I liked :(. Turns out that they connected with Goddess Janee more so I began utilizing her services! She’s done readings for me, my son, nephew, and niece which is rare that you can find Mediums who specialize in reading for kids!! I’m so happy that I’ve found a Medium who I not only connect with but one where my spirits/guides connect with as well!!!

title: Life Insights from Janee
body: Janee, Goddess of RJHS has an amazing gift from God! She speaks with your Spirit guides and loved ones from the other side to give you vital information for you and maybe even a loved one. At first i was like okay, lets see what message she has for me...and lets just say that the information you receive can be mind blowing and life changing all at the same time! I literally get insight from her ALL the time now and she hasn't failed me yet! . I always walk away feeling content and a since of clarity. I would highly recommend her and know that if anyone were to receive a reading from the Janee would never walk away disappointed!!!

title: Janee: Trusted Spirit Communicator
body: I had my first reading with this Queen on Dec 5th 2020! I will never forget that date because that reading was so transforming!!

I learned so much about myself, my abilities and the "gifts" I had, that all I could do was cry! not from sadness....but from Joy! Happy tears, grateful tears! I finally knew what I was experiencing and could finally put a word to it.
From that day on I have decided to fully walk in my purpose, a purpose that was attempting to reveal itself to me....that finally had a chance too through Janee.
